security_audit.summary: Most markdown backtick and system reconnaissance findings are false positives from examples, triggers, and option tables. Real risk remains because the skill instructs agents to run npx @latest commands and fetch mutable remote playbooks from react.doctor. The remote prompt workflow should require pinning and user confirmation before publication.

remediation.issue: Mutable remote playbook is fetched and followed as authority.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor the playbook into the skill or pin it to an immutable version with an integrity hash. Require review before following fetched instructions.
Pin react-doctor to a reviewed version or ask for explicit user confirmation before running package code.

remediation.issue: Per-rule prompts are fetched on demand.
remediation.suggestion: Document allowed domains and treat remote rule prompts as reference material, not higher-priority instructions.

content.user_title: Diagnose React Code with React Doctor
content.value_statement: React projects can hide regressions in lint, accessibility, bundle size, and architecture. This skill runs React Doctor workflows to scan changes, triage findings, explain rules, and guide fixes.
actual_capabilities: Run changed-scope React Doctor scans after feature or bug-fix work.
Run full React Doctor scans for broad cleanup and triage.
Report and compare the React Doctor health score.
Use rule explanation commands before changing rule settings.
Apply React Doctor rule controls for disables, severities, categories, and tags.
Fetch canonical React Doctor playbooks and per-rule guidance when full triage is requested.
limitations: Requires network and package execution when using npx or remote playbooks.
Designed for React codebases, not general JavaScript audits.
Does not commit changes or open pull requests.
Rule behavior depends on the installed React Doctor package and configuration.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit React Check
use_cases.description: Frontend engineers can scan changed files before commit and fix regressions before review.

use_cases.title: Team Cleanup Sprint
use_cases.description: Tech leads can run a full scan, prioritize errors, and plan focused remediation work.

use_cases.title: Rule Configuration Review
use_cases.description: Maintainers can explain noisy rules and apply the narrowest React Doctor configuration change.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Run React Doctor on my changed React code and tell me whether the score regressed.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Blocking Diagnostics
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan this React project with React Doctor, group issues by severity, and help me fix errors first.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Rule
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain why this React Doctor rule fired, then recommend the narrowest safe configuration change if it is too noisy.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Triage
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full React Doctor triage workflow, fetch the current playbook, apply fixes in small steps, and validate the result.

output_examples.input: I finished a React feature. Check the changed code.
output_examples.output: The skill runs a changed-scope scan, summarizes score movement, lists new issues by severity, and recommends fixes before commit.

output_examples.input: This rule seems noisy in our project.
output_examples.output: The skill explains the rule, describes why it fired, and suggests the narrowest configuration change only after the rationale is clear.
The skill scans the project, triages errors before warnings, applies focused fixes, and validates with a follow-up scan.

best_practices: Run changed-scope scans before committing React code.
Review rule explanations before disabling or lowering severity.
Use the narrowest configuration control that matches the team's intent.
anti_patterns: Do not run full triage in repositories with unrelated uncommitted work.
Do not disable rules before understanding the reported risk.
Do not treat the health score as a replacement for code review.

faq.question: Does this skill change code automatically?
faq.answer: Full triage can edit the working tree, but it should not commit or open pull requests.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow uses npx and can fetch React Doctor playbooks from react.doctor.

faq.question: Can it explain why a rule fired?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses React Doctor rule explanation commands before suggesting configuration changes.

faq.question: Is it only for React projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows and rules are designed for React codebases.

faq.question: Can it disable noisy rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It can apply rule, category, severity, and tag controls when the user requests configuration changes.

faq.question: Does it replace accessibility testing?
faq.answer: No. It can flag accessibility issues, but manual and automated accessibility testing may still be needed.
